title: Aqueous Polygalae Radix extract (PRE) prolongs the lifespan of C. elegans and alleviates D-galactose-induced oxidative stress in the mouse liver and brain by modulating PPARγ/MAPK
abstract: PRE delays aging and resists oxidative stress in organisms; it may act by regulating the PPARγ/MAPK signaling pathway and the intestinal flora. The efficacy and mechanism of PRE against oxidative stress were elucidated using RNA-seq and 16S rDNA sequencing, providing a reference for antiaging and aging-related diseases.
